info.title: "Ippon" again!
info.synopsis: Dopo essersi esibiti in un torneo di judo della scuola media, Michi e Sanae iniziano il liceo. Le due ragazze incontrano l'ultima avversaria di Michi, la quale lotta per salvare il club di judo del loro nuovo liceo.

episodes.title: Ippon!
episodes.synopsis: Michi may be in high spirits, but Sanae knows her friend; she can sense that something’s bothering her.

episodes.title: Formed! Revived! Restarted!
episodes.synopsis: Sanae’s parents insist she focuses on her grades instead of judo. But if Sanae does that, not only will she give up her passion, but she’d be letting her friends down too.

episodes.title: She Changes the Mood Entirely
episodes.synopsis: The judo club has an advisor, and they are extremely worried about who it could be. And to make matters worse? Towa is about to run into someone she may wish she hadn’t.

episodes.title: With the Three of Us, We`ll Be Fine
episodes.synopsis: The judo club takes part in their first qualifier, so it’s normal to feel the pressure. Sanae is such a bundle of nerves that it may affect her performance.

episodes.title: Judo Feels So Wonderful, Doesn`t It?
episodes.synopsis: Michi and Ami find themselves evenly matched. And, as the seconds tick down, both girls grow more determined to score an ippon to win.

episodes.title: I Don`t Want to Have Regrets
episodes.synopsis: Nagumo is great at kendo. She loves the sport, but something’s missing.

episodes.title: Secret Weapon Senpai
episodes.synopsis: The judo club plan to compete in the Kinshuki tournament, but a team of five is required and the club only has four members. Fortunately, Natsume has someone in mind.

episodes.title: The Continuation of That Dream
episodes.synopsis: The judo club is now five strong as they head to the Kinshuki. Michi becomes fast friends with a first year who is an opponent they’ll face in the first round!

episodes.title: Softness Subdues Hardness
episodes.synopsis: Michi is in her element, and her power and speed transform her into a force to be reckoned with.

episodes.title: There`s an Option Besides Winning?
episodes.synopsis: They made it to the second round, but the tournament only gets harder from here. Especially since their opponent is the prefectural singles runner-up.

episodes.title: Golden Era
episodes.synopsis: Here comes a new challenger!

episodes.title: I`m the Strongest I`ve Ever Been
episodes.synopsis: Hana Odagiri’s tenacity stops Aoba West’s momentum dead in its tracks. If they can’t take her down soon, they can kiss their tournament dreams goodbye.

episodes.title: Another Ippon!
episodes.synopsis: This is it. The match that will decide everything, and the stakes couldn’t be higher.

info.title: Sanda (ITA)
info.synopsis: Kazushige Sanda, uno studente delle medie, un giorno viene aggredito con un coltello dal compagno di classe Fuyumura. Nonostante all'inizio Sanda non riesca a dare un senso all'assurda situazione in cui si è trovato, poco alla volta si convince che le azioni di Fuyumura siano state dei semplici atti meschini causati dal fatto che quest'ultimo sta affrontando una peculiare fase della pubertà. In realtà, Fuyumura ha agito così perché sospetta che Mita sia il discendente di una certa famiglia...

episodes.title: Everything`s Bright, Am I Aging?
episodes.synopsis: On a Dec 25 without Christmas, Sanda is attacked by classmate Shiori. Mistaking it for love, he awaits her confession, but hears something else.

episodes.title: Candies, Canes, Kisses, and Blades
episodes.synopsis: Amaya learns Sanda is Santa, restrains him and Shiori to force a kiss. Santa refuses, unlocks sled power to escape. Then Headmaster Oshibu appears!

episodes.title: Charred Fruit Tastes All the Sweeter
episodes.synopsis: Sanda gains lie-detecting power. Shiori tries to use it to find Ono, but doubt overwhelms Sanda. Shiori then tells a self-harming lie.

episodes.title: Zeus, Smasher of Textbooks
episodes.synopsis: At a funeral, Santa fights Yagiuda but fears his power. His resolve returns, shattering the roof and leaving him exposed before all.

episodes.title: A Typhoon in a Snow Globe
episodes.synopsis: Sanda vows never to love, but in a typhoon his message to fiancee Niko fails and he's drawn to her. The next day, Yagiuda arrives as a teacher.

episodes.title: Cyborg vs. Santa Claus
episodes.synopsis: Santa blocks Headmaster Oshibu from attacking adult Ono, but the enhanced 92-year-old overpowers him. Santa asks the kids for their belief to fight.

episodes.title: Double-Faced Carnivorous Plant
episodes.synopsis: Amaya ends his friendship with Sanda to save him. Meanwhile, the scarred Oshibu, comforted by Yagiuda, turns to Class 10 students who killed adults.

episodes.title: Love, the Most Selfish Thing There Is
episodes.synopsis: Saved from Namatame by Shiori, Santa vows to harden his heart, but when Niko asks for a kiss, Sanda panics and almost transforms before her.

episodes.title: A Fake Flower, Yet Its Roots Rot
episodes.synopsis: Tetsudome says Santa lacks grit. With her aid Sanda becomes dark Santa, but doubts himself. After meeting Namatame again, he vows not to fight kids.

episodes.title: You, an Everlasting Moment
episodes.synopsis: At the Peak of Youth Ceremony, Niko steals Sanda's first kiss at twilight. Meanwhile Yagiuda faces Namatame alone, offering himself as decoy.

episodes.title: Flashback Attack
episodes.synopsis: Namatame wrecks the ceremony. Eating yakisoba, she's met by Sanda in child form. His body starts breaking down as Ono's own changes grow.

episodes.title: Pale Blue Pall
episodes.synopsis: Santa fights Oshibu before the students. The headmaster thrives on cheers, but Santa regains power by revealing his truth. The duel peaks on the roof.

info.synopsis: Terza stagione di Star Wars: Visions

episodes.title: Il Duello: La Vendetta
episodes.synopsis: Con l'aiuto di alleanze inaspettate, Ronin affronta un Jedi corrotto in cerca di vendetta.

episodes.title: Il Canto delle Quattro Ali
episodes.synopsis: Una principessa diventata ribelle protegge un bambino dall'ira dell'Impero.

episodes.title: Il Nono Jedi Figlia della Speranza
episodes.synopsis: Persa nello spazio e inseguita dai Cacciatori di Jedi, Kara si imbatte in un astro nave e un droide.

episodes.title: I Cacciatori di Taglie
episodes.synopsis: L'incarico di cacciatrice di taglie assegnatole avrà conseguenze per lei e il suo droide.

episodes.title: Il Tesoro di Yuko
episodes.synopsis: Un orfano si unisce a un ragazzo di strada per salvare il suo droide e trovare un tesoro perduto.

episodes.title: Perduti
episodes.synopsis: Mentre aiuta dei rifugiati, una F in incognito deve fare i conti con i fantasmi del suo passato.

episodes.title: La Contrabbandiera
episodes.synopsis: In cerca di denaro, una contrabbandiera accetta di salvare un principe dalle grinfie dell'Impero.

episodes.title: L'Uccello del Paradiso
episodes.synopsis: Accerchiato in battaglia, un Jedi Padawan affronta una serie di prove per resistere al Lato Oscuro.

episodes.title: NERO
episodes.synopsis: Una battaglia psichedelica prende forma nella mente tormentata di un soldato dell'Impero.

info.title: The Case Book of Arne
info.synopsis: Arne Neuntöte è un detective vampiro in grado di manipolare i poteri soprannaturali. Lynn Reinweiß è la figlia di un nobile che adora i vampiri. Normalmente i loro mondi non avrebbero mai dovuto incrociarsi, ma in una notte buia Lynn finisce per vagare nella misteriosa città di Lügenberg dove vivono coloro che non sono umani. Il mondo della ragazza cambia quando incontra Arne, un vampiro che è definito "il peggiore" dagli abitanti della città, proprio quando sta indagando ad un nuovo caso di omicidio. Qual è la verità dietro i bizzarri incidenti che si verificano in un mondo dove l'umano ed il soprannaturale si intersecano?

episodes.title: Those Who Dig Pits for Others Will Fall in Themselves
episodes.synopsis: Louis Hartmann joins forces with the members of the Arne Detective Agency to investigate his father's murder.

episodes.title: There Is Always Sunshine After the Rain
episodes.synopsis: Lynn remembers the time she first met Arne and hired him to help investigate her father's suspicious behavior.

episodes.title: Misfortune Never Visits Alone
episodes.synopsis: Arne makes a shocking discovery about Lynn's father and Gordon reveals the dark truth of the Reinweiß mansion.

episodes.title: Those Who Never Gamble Never Win
episodes.synopsis: Lynn and Arne are both troubled by surprise encounters that threaten to alter the course of the investigation.

episodes.title: One Swallow Does Not a Summer Make!
episodes.synopsis: Lynn and Arne assemble the servants to review the clues and sniff out the killers through deductive reasoning.

episodes.title: Time Will Tell
episodes.synopsis: A distraught mermaid arrives at the detective agency searching for the reason why her lover tried to kill her.

episodes.title: Eating Whets the Appetite
episodes.synopsis: Arne tracks down a jewel thief while Lynn investigates a series of disappearances connected to an art museum.

episodes.title: Desire and Love Make All Burdens Lighter
episodes.synopsis: Lynn and Arne trace the mysteries of the missing men and lost piece of jewelry to their shocking conclusions.

episodes.title: Not All That Glitters Is Gold
episodes.synopsis: Arne and Lynn are asked to investigate a man who appears to have started cheating on his wife after an injury.

episodes.title: Different Countries, Different Customs
episodes.synopsis: Arne decides to investigate a locked-room murder on a whim and soon realizes that it may not be what it seems.

episodes.title: Birds of a Feather Flock Together
episodes.synopsis: Arne uncovers a disturbing connection between all five of the cases investigated by the Arne Detective Agency.

episodes.title: All`s Well That Ends Well
episodes.synopsis: Lynn and friends battle their way through Dracula's soldiers as they race to rescue Arne before it's too late.

info.title: Panzer World Galient
info.synopsis: Ambientato nel lontano mondo dall'aspetto medievale di Arst, il Principe Jordy Volder intraprende la lotta contro le ambizioni del conquistatore Marder. Jordy utilizza il leggendario robot gigante "panzer" Galient, che è uno dei molti panzer conservati sottoterra da migliaia di anni. Usando un esercito di panzer robotici avanzati, Marder sta conquistando tutta Arst in preparazione del suo piano di dominio sulla Galassia Crescente.

info.title: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class
info.synopsis: Maehara Maki è un ragazzo che ha problemi a fare conoscenza con le persone, e questo lo porta a non avere nessun amico fino a quando inizia il liceo. Qui conosce Asanagi, una ragazza che viene chiamata alle sue spalle "la seconda ragazza più carina della classe", e i due fanno amicizia. Ogni venerdì Asanagi rifiuta gli inviti della sua migliore amica Amami, colei che è ritenuta la più bella della classe, per poter passare del tempo con Maehara. Insieme passano il tempo a giocare, guardare film, leggere manga e mangiare cibo spazzatura senza preoccuparsi in nessun modo del mondo. Per le altre persone questi momenti potrebbero sembrare una perdita di tempo, ma per i due ragazzi sono veramente preziosi.

episodes.title: The Girl Named Asanagi Umi
episodes.synopsis: Maehara Maki bombs his intro at his new school, but it somehow comes back to help him.

episodes.title: Asanagi Umi and Amami Yuu
episodes.synopsis: When Maki and Umi go have fun outside, they run into some unexpected surprises.

episodes.title: The Second Prettiest Girl in Class
episodes.synopsis: As Maki and Yuu become friends, how will Umi react?

episodes.title: The Two and Their School Festival
episodes.synopsis: Yuu confronts the class about their treatment of Maki. How will this whole mess get resolved?

episodes.title: From Now on, and Then On
episodes.synopsis: Umi tells Maki how she and Yuu met, as well as the evolution of their friendship.

episodes.title: December with Friends
episodes.synopsis: While Maki's still reeling from Umi's declaration, he gets approached about something to do with Yuu.

episodes.title: First Date with a Friend
episodes.synopsis: After shopping, Maki and Umi go on their date, but the person Maki ran into lingers in his mind.

episodes.title: Family Sights
episodes.synopsis: After a study session with Umi, Yuu, and Seki, Maki confronts his father about a thorny issue.

episodes.title: Family Sights: Part Two
episodes.synopsis: Maki hasn't had the chance to sort out his feelings toward his family, and now he must go meet Umi's folks.

episodes.title: One Last Tantrum
episodes.synopsis: Maki has a plan to release his repressed feelings about his parents' divorce.

episodes.title: New Year`s as Lovers
episodes.synopsis: Maki falls ill after everything that has happened, and Umi offers to take care of him.

episodes.title: To a New Season
episodes.synopsis: Valentine's Day is coming up, as is Umi's birthday. How do Maki and the gang feel as they head into spring?

info.title: Questa allegra gioventù - Un'estate lunga un sogno (ITA)
info.synopsis: Quel giorno, all'aeroporto, Katsuhiko lo aveva promesso, con dolce fermezza: "Tra due anni tornerò in Giappone per sposarti". In quel momento, Kasumi non aveva potuto far altro che osservare in silenzio Katsuhiko mentre spariva dietro la scala mobile, diretto all'aereo che lo avrebbe portato negli Stati Uniti. Due anni possono passare in fretta, ma tutto può accadere. E quando Katsuhiko torna, ricco e famoso, in Kasumi non ci sono certezze. Da qualche parte, in una stanza segreta nel profondo del suo cuore che la stessa Kasumi esita ad aprire, sembra essere germogliato un sentimento per l'incorreggibile, fanfarone e sincero Yusaku. Finchè l'imprevisto accade...

related.title: Questa allegra gioventù - Un'estate lunga un sogno

variants.title: Questa allegra gioventù - Un'estate lunga un sogno

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis:
The movie starts out with Katsuhiko going to the US, with Kasumi and Yusaku seeing him off at Narita.

Two years later, Katsuhiko is a professional racer, and comes back to Japan to race (and to marry Kasumi). Yusaku's hobby is photography.

info.title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA
info.synopsis: Nuovo progetto animato del franchise BanG Dream!, che mette in risalto i membri della band in Mugendai Mewtype.

episodes.title: Mewtype
episodes.synopsis: A band activity that starts suddenly. There's a reason she wants to run away from "singing"... Even so, the story begins to move relentlessly.

episodes.title: Smooch!
episodes.synopsis: An era where a single word can lead to a social media firestorm. Words intended to protect end up hurting someone. Even so, she says with a smile—

episodes.title: Suit Yourself!
episodes.synopsis: The relationship moves forward, but that's all. As a band, nothing has started yet. And then, another encounter arrives—

episodes.title: Might Be Fun
episodes.synopsis: The activities of the four members seem to be going smoothly. However, a relationship that was supposed to be distant begins to move. Feelings that were being ignored start to seep out—

episodes.title: Help
episodes.synopsis: Pretending to be okay, pretending to be energetic. That sense of unease can no longer be hidden. Far away, a single gear begins to shift out of place--

episodes.title: Destiny
episodes.synopsis: Apologizing, feeling depressed, thinking everything was ruined. It's still continuing. It's not over yet. Can they truly face each other once more?

episodes.title: Turning Over a New Leaf
episodes.synopsis: At that time, one was chosen. Beyond that, the scenery changes just a little. But, that doesn't mean everything will go well.

episodes.title: Gold Star
episodes.synopsis: There is a desire to help. But that alone isn't enough. By the time you realize it, it might already be too late—

episodes.title: Disbandment
episodes.synopsis: One leaves, one holds on, one steps forward, and one stands still. The other one-- hasn't been able to choose anything yet. They might not be able to go back anymore--

episodes.title: Sea
episodes.synopsis: Swaying, colliding, and the shape begins to crumble. I don't want it to end here. Even if I'm swept away, I will find it properly.

episodes.title: That Was Fun
episodes.synopsis: If we stay close, it's truly warm. If we hadn't separated, it should have been fine. But—that fire will no longer stop.

episodes.title: Goodbye
episodes.synopsis: Warmth alone is not enough to convey. If you stay silent, nothing will change. So—I won't run away.

episodes.title: Mugendai Mewtype
episodes.synopsis: Even the feelings that were hidden are turned into songs as they are. Remaining different, yet standing in the same place. From this stage, it's going to get even more fun. That voice will spread everywhere.

info.title: Blades of the Guardians
info.synopsis: Dao Ma, un misterioso cacciatore di taglie, viaggia nelle regioni più remote dell'impero accompagnato dal piccolo Xiao Qi. Quando accetta un incarico che lo porterà fino alla capitale imperiale, Chang'an, sia lui che la persona che è incaricato di scortare finiranno nel mirino di diverse fazioni assetate di sangue e di potere.

episodes.title: Escorts Outside the Great Wall
episodes.synopsis: On his way to Mo's, Dao Ma finds a bounty on a criminal called the Two-headed Snake. Though Mo warns Dao Ma of the danger of the task, Dao Ma does not have the luxury to refuse 6000 coins.

episodes.title: Two-headed Snake
episodes.synopsis: In search of the Double-Headed Snake, Dao Ma reaches a town called Chisha. The town is being dictated by a Government Official Chang Guiren. He proposes Dao Ma to work in his battalion to keep the so-called rebellions at bay.

episodes.title: Turbulent
episodes.synopsis: After killing the government official of the Chisha, Dao Ma now has a 50,000 gold coins bounty on his head. He returns to Mo only to find a mysterious man waiting to seek his aid, named Zhi Shilang who wants to visit Chang'an.

episodes.title: Jade Face and Beauty
episodes.synopsis: On their way to Chang'an, Dao and the group notice a swordsman (Shu) fighting off Rakshasan-worshipers. Dao Ma offers to help the guy in exchange for his carriage. But the guy does not seem to be friendly at all.

episodes.title: Trade
episodes.synopsis: Being cornered by the enemy Shu had to accept Dao Ma's help. It looks like Shu's destination is also Chang'an where he is to be returning a fugitive to his master.

episodes.title: Chess and Game
episodes.synopsis: The heads of the great five families are summoned by Pei Suji, by the imperial order. Lao Ma is against what the secretary of the emperor offers and he has to pay gravely for that.

episodes.title: Wolf Children
episodes.synopsis: Lao Mo is dead and Yuji encounters Ayuya in the middle of the road to make her his bride. Dao Ma is beside himself with rage.

episodes.title: Sandstorm is Coming
episodes.synopsis: Shu gets involved in Dao Ma's revenge battle. The heads of five families which has now become four are on the road for the blood of Zhi Shilang.

episodes.title: People of the Desert
episodes.synopsis: The huge sandstorm disrupts Dao Ma's battle for revenge. But Ayuya decides to leave the group to seek her own personal revenge for her father.

episodes.title: The Great Sandstorm
episodes.synopsis: Like the sandstorm she is, Ayuya turns back and kills two of her father's killers but gets outnumbered by the enemy soon. To save her and keep her master's wish, A Ni makes the ultimate sacrifice.

episodes.title: Hua Yan Tuan
episodes.synopsis: Zhi Shilang explains his origin and goal. Dao Ma is adamant to get Ayuya back dead or alive.

episodes.title: The Khan and the General
episodes.synopsis: General Pei rescues Ayuya but can not get out of the enemy's grasp yet. Dao Ma and the group plan an attack to get Ayuya back.

episodes.title: The Truth
episodes.synopsis: General Pei stands before the enemy all alone. Dao Ma and Shu are waiting patiently for the right moment to strike. Buddha's Calvary makes an unexpected move.

episodes.title: The Winner and the Crown
episodes.synopsis: In the midst of a bloody battle, a prophecy came true and revenge was served.

episodes.title: Daughter of the desert
episodes.synopsis: After getting her revenge, Ayuya decides to part from Dao Ma and join the Buddha's Chivalry. Dao Ma, Shu, and Zhi Shilang move towards another destination.
